# Alibre Design Explorer Refresh Tool

- This is a small command-line tool that refreshes the Design Explorer of the part you have open, which helps when the feature tree stops reflecting the model.
  - What it does
    - Connects to a copy of Alibre Design that is already running.
    - Works on whichever part session is at the front.
    - Turns each feature in the part back on.
    - Rebuilds the model and saves the file.
    - Tells you if Alibre is not running, or if the session at the front is not a part.
  - What you need
    - Alibre Design installed and running with a part open.
    - The .NET Framework 4.8.1 runtime on 64-bit Windows.
  - Getting started
    - Build `source/ADDesignExplorerRefresh.sln` in Release configuration.
    - Open the part you want to refresh in Alibre Design.
    - Run the executable, and it will refresh and save that part.
  - Where things live
    - `source/` holds the VB.NET console project.
    - `documentation/` holds reference notes.
  - Good to know
    - The tool saves the part as its final step, so close anything you do not want written to disk.
